_about: Single source of truth for the fable-lead role pins. Edit here (or `fable-lead-pins set`), then `fable-lead-pins apply`. Model keys are exact ids or cswap-stats longest-prefix price keys; prices are $/MTok [input, output, cache-write-5m, cache-write-1h, cache-read]; calibrated_on is DATE:EXPERIMENT.

scout.use_for: answer ONE question for the head by reading
scout.evidence: unmeasured; low blast radius (the head re-reads the decisive lines)

finder.use_for: return a SET a pipeline builds on; nothing restores a miss
finder.evidence: 004 B (n=2/2/1): sonnet found a third as much (9 vs 26/run); fable/medium most (33) at 1.35×; two runs' union beat one better run. 005 B (n=2/2/1): Opus 5.5 found 2.5–3.0/10 known vs 6/10 for Opus 5 at 42% of the cost — it misses

builder.use_for: implementation with no test that defines done
builder.evidence: 005 C, 12 test-driven fixes, script-graded: 12/12 for Opus 5/high and Opus 5.5 at medium and high; 5.5/medium at 52% of the meter cost, 68% of the time, a third of the tool calls; high bought nothing

builder-tdd.use_for: implementation where FAILING TESTS define done
builder-tdd.evidence: 004 C, 12 tasks/arm, script-graded: every tier 12/12 (Wilson lower bound 76%, a ceiling); sonnet −56% quota, −33% time; opus/xhigh +19% for nothing

verifier.evidence: Part A, 16 claims × 2 votes: 32/32 = opus/high (Wilson lower bound 89%, ceiling) at −66% quota

adjudicator.evidence: 003: both errors sat in split votes, 46/46 agreeing pairs correct

synthesizer.use_for: the one output that ships verbatim

mechanical.use_for: work a test or compiler makes loud when wrong

price_header: API rates in $/MTok (input, output, cache-write-5m 1.25x, cache-write-1h
2.0x, cache-read 0.1x), from the claude-api pricing reference cached
2026-06-24. On Max plans this is API-equivalent VALUE consumed, not money
spent. Longest-prefix match. The 5m/1h split matters: ~45% of this
and pricing them at 1.25x understated value ~7-9%.
Re-verified 2026-09-18: Fable 5.1 cache reads are 0.025x ($0.25), not the
0.1x its "claude-fable-5" prefix used to inherit — that overstated every
5.1 message since 2026-09-08 (cache reads are ~96% of tokens). Mythos 5.1's
cache-read rate was still open at launch, so it keeps the 5.x rate. Sonnet 5

columns are the standard 1.25x/2x multipliers (ESTIMATED, "confirm at launch")

verifier.source: ~/.claude/experiments/tier-ab-006/DESIGN.md, 'Corrections and rule v2' (pre-registered 2026-09-28, before the refuter re-run)
verifier.text: v2: move to the candidate iff (a) union known-defect recall on CLEAN diffs >= the incumbent's AND (b) precision on DISTINCT unmatched claims >= 0.70 AND (c) meter-$ per vote <= the incumbent's; tie-break between candidate efforts: the lower effort if its union recall is within one defect of the higher
